# Laboratory-abnormality label coverage (generated by experiments/check_laboratory_label_coverage.py)

HPO terms whose logical definition names a ChEBI entity (hp-base.owl): 688 (increased 341, abnormal, no direction 205, decreased 142). Terms mapped to a Human-GEM metabolite: 222 through an equivalent form (conjugate acid or base, tautomer), 163 through a specific form (an is_a child named after the compound, such as L-phenylalanine), 98 through a manual mapping (elements and ions named differently in HPO and Human-GEM; compounds HPO names in a generic, neutral or racemic form such as glucose and lactic acid; and class names mapped to the members a clinical test measures, such as ketone bodies and catecholamines: MANUAL_HUMAN_GEM_MAPPINGS), 6 left out as class terms (more than three metabolites), 199 unmapped. Generic pseudo-metabolites ('[protein]') are excluded; an unannotated gene-metabolite pair is unlabelled, not normal.
